statements.justification: The quoted MHE_vs_noMHE values match the uploaded data (CD36 mRNA +0.63, relevant; IL4 mRNA +0.66, relevant; serum IL4 cytokine +0.01, not relevant), and Ref [1] supports PPARγ-dependent CD36 induction in exogenously IL-4-stimulated human macrophages in vitro. However, proposing an IL-4/PPARγ/CD36 macrophage axis in peripheral blood is undermined by the flat circulating IL-4 protein (+0.01) and non-significant downstream mediators in the same blood transcriptome: PPARG (+0.29), IL4R (−0.14), IL2RG (−0.27), STAT6 (−0.35), ALOX15 (−0.44), and MRC1 (−0.04) are all not relevant. Indeed, Rubio 2021 concludes from decreased IL4R/IL2R that overall Th2 activity declines in MHE.
statements.in_paper_where: Results, 'Transcriptomic analysis confirms changes in the immunophenotype in MHE patients and unveils new altered pathways' (IL4 in Fig. 2B; CD36 in lipid pathways and Fig. 4C) and Table 2.

statements.justification: Serum IL6 is strongly up-regulated in MHE (+1.89, relevant; Table 2 median 3.70 vs 1.15 pg/mL) whereas blood-cell IL6 mRNA is flat (+0.04, not relevant). Cited Ref [2] directly supports serum IL-6 as an independent clinical predictor of overt hepatic encephalopathy risk in human cirrhosis. Attributing this protein-dominant signal to extra-blood-cell (e.g., hepatic) IL-6 production is biologically sound and aligns with the paper's discussion of plasma cytokine sources.
statements.in_paper_where: Results, Table 2 and Module 1 (Fig. 3–4); Discussion and Supplementary Table S3 (blood mRNA vs. plasma cytokine sources).

statements.justification: Although blood-cell IL4 (+0.66), AHR (+0.50), and CYP1B1 (+0.92) transcripts are relevant while serum IL4 is flat (+0.01, not relevant), the two arms were linked only across an unconnected walk jump and Ref [3] does not transfer here. Ref [3] shows TCDD-activated AhR inducing CCL1 in exogenously IL-4-polarized macrophages and correlating monocyte AhR binding with plasma IL-4 protein levels, whereas circulating IL-4 protein here is unchanged (+0.01). Moreover, the required macrophage intermediates IL4R (−0.14), STAT6 (−0.35), KDM6B (−0.10), and ARNT (−0.19) are all non-relevant and negative in the uploaded blood transcriptome, and CCL1 is unmeasured.
statements.in_paper_where: Results, Fig. 2B (IL4 transcript up-regulation) and Table 2 (serum cytokines).

statements.justification: The uploaded data confirm elevated serum IL6 (+1.89, relevant) alongside a flat blood-cell IL6 transcript (+0.04, not relevant) and up-regulated monocyte/macrophage marker CD163 (+0.62, relevant). Refs [4] and [5] directly corroborate elevated serum IL-6 as an independent diagnostic predictor of MHE in cirrhotic cohorts. Although redundant with S2, every data reading, citation, and biological claim in S4 is accurate.
statements.in_paper_where: Results, Table 2 and Module 1 (Fig. 3–4); Discussion and Supplementary Table S3 (blood mRNA vs. plasma cytokines).

statements.justification: Quoted MHE_vs_noMHE values match across both layers: IL4 mRNA is significantly up (+0.66, relevant) with flat serum IL4 (+0.01, not relevant), while TNF mRNA is significantly down (−0.45, relevant) with serum TNF non-significantly positive (+0.46, not relevant, appropriately hedged as 'trends up'). Clinical MHE studies in Refs [7, 8] support elevated circulating TNF-α and IL-6 in MHE, and Rubio 2021 explicitly notes compartment-specific cytokine mRNA–protein divergence and hepatic TNFα contribution in the Discussion.
statements.in_paper_where: Results (IL4 mRNA in Fig. 2B; TNF mRNA in Supplementary Fig. S1; Table 2); Discussion and Supplementary Table S3 (mRNA vs. plasma cytokine discordance and hepatic TNFα).

statements.justification: While PSME1 mRNA is significantly down in MHE (−0.52, relevant), claiming 'while IFNG is up' misreads a non-significant change (IFNG +0.33, not relevant at FDR >= 0.05) as active induction. Other IFN-γ/immunoproteasome pathway genes in the uploaded table are significantly down (TNF −0.45, relevant, which the paper itself pairs with PSME1) or trend negative (STAT1 −0.46, IRF1 −0.37, PSMB8/9/10 −0.22 to −0.23, all not relevant). Furthermore, cited Ref [9] shows PA28 induction in HCV-infected chimpanzee liver correlates with type I IFN and precedes IFN-γ by weeks, failing to support IFN-γ-driven PSME1 induction.
statements.in_paper_where: Results, 'Transcriptomic analysis confirms changes in the immunophenotype in MHE patients and unveils new altered pathways' (PSME1 and TNF down-regulation in Supplementary Fig. S1; IFNG in Fig. 2B).

statements.justification: The blood-cell MHE_vs_noMHE values match (HOXA9 +0.53, relevant; MEIS1 −0.62, relevant; FLT3 +0.34, not relevant), but the HOXA9–MEIS1–FLT3 axis comes from an OmniPath acute myeloid leukemia edge and Ref [10] on retroviral Meis1/Hoxa9 leukemogenesis in mouse hematopoietic stem cells (CD34 is −0.10, not relevant here). That leukemic progenitor context does not transfer to adult peripheral blood leukocytes in non-leukemic cirrhotic patients. Exposing raw walk IDs '(e39–e41)' merely to report that two co-factors diverge and FLT3 is unchanged is uninformative graph-topology filler.

Although PDGFRB (+0.76), EREG (+0.64), and AREG (+1.96) match the uploaded blood transcriptome, invoking hepatic stellate cell (HSC) activation in CCl4 mouse liver fibrosis (Ref [11]) misreads both the assayed tissue (whole peripheral blood leukocytes, not liver-resident HSCs) and the clinical contrast (MHE vs noMHE within patients who all already have cirrhosis). Biochemically, EREG and AREG are EGFR ligands that do not bind PDGFRβ—they were linked only via KEGG's pooled MAPK growth-factor/RTK metanode. In the uploaded table, PDGFRB's cognate ligand PDGFB is significantly down (−0.62, relevant) and EGFR is flat (+0.12, not relevant).

The blood-transcript values match (DHCR24 −0.72, relevant; SC5D +0.60, relevant; EBP −0.02, DHCR7 −0.20, and LIPA +0.06, all not relevant), and Ref [12] accurately describes DHCR24 catalysing the terminal desmosterol-to-cholesterol step. However, S9 misclassifies LIPA (lysosomal acid lipase, which hydrolyses lipoprotein-derived cholesteryl esters and triglycerides in lysosomes) as one of 'the post-squalene cholesterol-synthesis enzymes' due to a side reaction on KEGG hsa00100. Meanwhile, it omits the actual post-squalene sterol reductase TM7SF2 (−0.64, relevant) in the same pathway.

While APOB (−0.97, relevant) and LIPA (+0.06, not relevant) match the uploaded MHE_vs_noMHE table, the transcriptomics assay profiles peripheral blood leukocytes—which do not assemble or secrete VLDL or chylomicrons—rather than hepatocytes or enterocytes. Furthermore, all 11 study participants in both groups already have liver cirrhosis (with hepatocellular carcinoma excluded). Linking blood-cell APOB mRNA down-regulation in MHE to hepatocyte MDM2-mediated VLDL retention [13] and germline APOB loss-of-function predisposition to steatotic liver disease and cirrhosis [14] therefore misapplies both tissue physiology and experimental contrast.
statements.in_paper_where: Results, 'Transcriptomic analysis confirms changes in the immunophenotype in MHE patients and unveils new altered pathways' (APOB down-regulation in lipid metabolism pathways).

overall.comment: Numeric fold-changes and relevance flags were quoted accurately across all 10 statements, but 7 of 10 statements failed scientific review due to severe tissue/context misapplications, pathway-database artefacts, and ignoring unwalked pathway intermediates. Of Rubio 2021's three main conclusions, the report touched elevated serum IL-6 and blood-vs-serum cytokine discordance (S2, S4, S5—with S2 and S4 nearly duplicating each other) and isolated lipid transcripts (CD36, APOB, DHCR24/SC5D), but missed the core T-cell subset shift (CD4/Th17/B-cell up vs CD8/MHC-II/Th2-receptor down), missed the multi-chemokine chemotaxis module, and missed the entire serum phospholipid–PLA2G4A metabolomic axis (as 0 of 143 Biocrates metabolites mapped to KEGG IDs). Recurring failure modes included equating peripheral blood leukocyte mRNA with hepatocyte VLDL secretion (S10) or liver stellate-cell fibrosis (S8) in an already-cirrhotic cohort, invoking extracellular IL-4 macrophage polarization despite flat serum IL-4 and uninduced IL4R/STAT6/PPARG (S1, S3), treating non-significant IFNG (+0.33) as up with a non-supporting type-I-IFN citation (S6), misclassifying lysosomal lipase LIPA as a post-squalene sterol-synthesis enzyme (S9), and narrating an irrelevant AML stem-cell chain (S7).
